capture: Read-only GET of the GitHub REST pulls/{n}/reviews endpoint, the source of gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n}/reviews. Captured without authentication because gh auth was unavailable.
normalization: Selected one submitted review from each list. Only commit_id is replaced with aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa to match the existing pull and check fixtures. All other fields, including id, user, and state, are retained from the response.
